purpose: A traceable design-research corpus for improving the Cortex landing page without copying external interfaces or assets.

sourceOfTruth.primary: The existing pixel-art blue hero in src/screens/HeroLabScreen.tsx
sourceOfTruth.rule: References inform decisions; the hero remains the visual authority.

usagePolicy.extract: Patterns, hierarchy, motion principles, composition, typography behavior, responsive intent and interaction logic.
usagePolicy.adapt: Translate findings into Cortex primitives rather than reproducing a source website.
usagePolicy.licensing: Treat gallery screenshots and linked work as copyrighted unless an explicit license says otherwise. DESIGN.md examples from designmd.app are reported as CC BY 4.0 by its terms; attribution is required if a file is copied.

sources.name: Inspora
sources.observed: The URL was provided in the reference list, but the current automated crawl returned an internal error.

sources.name: posts.design
sources.observed: A curated wall of recent social posts with author, source, post type and capture date.
sources.cortexTranslation: Study how one message is framed and paced; do not import social-card geometry into the landing page.

sources.name: loadmo.re
sources.observed: An archive dedicated to alternative mobile websites, tagged across animation, AI and generative, editorial, minimal, tactile, typography, glitches and video.
sources.cortexTranslation: Use mobile as a deliberate composition, not a desktop card grid collapsed to one column.

sources.name: Refero Styles
sources.observed: A library of real website styles packaged as agent-readable design systems with colors, typography, spacing, components and rationale.
sources.cortexTranslation: Use the format and discipline, not another brand's visual tokens.

sources.name: Recent
sources.observed: A daily curation with separate browsing surfaces for design, websites, OG images, app screenshots and app icons, plus resource categories.
sources.cortexTranslation: Use the archive to detect quality and pacing, not to chase current trends.

sources.name: 60fps
sources.observed: A library of delightful interface details organized into shots, apps, app sites, motion, snippets and storyboards, with tags such as reveal, morph, parallax, particles, pulse, drag and onboarding.
sources.cortexTranslation: Borrow the idea of purposeful reveal and physical response; reject motion that exists only to demonstrate technology.

sources.name: Supahero
sources.observed: A curated hero-section library now presented as part of ScreensDesign, with a broad catalog of named hero references.
sources.cortexTranslation: The Cortex hero is already stronger than a generic gallery sample; use Supahero only to audit composition mechanics.

sources.name: Navbar Gallery
sources.observed: A navigation-focused gallery organized around static navbars, dropdowns, mega menus, progress bars, sidebars, search bars, announcements, full-screen navigation and tabs.
sources.cortexTranslation: Keep the existing capsule shell and simplify decisions; do not turn the landing into a navigation showcase.

sources.name: CTA.gallery
sources.observed: A CTA gallery with filters for button, call-to-buy, download, form, modal, navigation, newsletter, pricing or subscription and templates, plus industry and mode filters.
sources.cortexTranslation: Cortex uses one primary action per moment; avoid button clusters and generic conversion panels.

sources.name: Refero
sources.observed: A searchable research library spanning product screens, flows, UX patterns and UI elements such as navigation, footer, animation, cards, tables and command palettes.
sources.cortexTranslation: Use for the product later; do not let dashboard patterns leak into the public landing.

sources.name: Mobbin
sources.observed: A large library of real app screens and flows, with an official MCP entry point for AI tools on eligible plans.
sources.cortexTranslation: Use evidence from shipped products for UX decisions; never use the library as a license to reproduce screens.

sources.name: designmd.app
sources.observed: An open library of 461 DESIGN.md files with YAML tokens and Markdown rationale, organized around overview, colors, typography, layout, elevation, shapes, components and do/don't rules.
sources.cortexTranslation: Adopt the structure for Cortex while writing original rules from the hero.

sources.name: Landing.Gallery
sources.observed: A manually reviewed landing-page library with full-page screenshots, page-type tags and detected tools or technologies.
sources.cortexTranslation: Study complete journeys, not isolated component crops.

sources.name: Land-book
sources.observed: A curated landing-page gallery with filters for industry, style, type, typography, color and platform.
sources.cortexTranslation: Use filters to reject generic SaaS patterns and find light, image-led, spacious work.

sources.name: Footer Design
sources.observed: A footer-specific gallery organized by type and style, including typographic, small type, illustrative, grid, flat, animated, cards, bright, dark, large type and bold.
sources.cortexTranslation: Use the closing as a final authored scene, never as a generic sitemap block.

sources.name: SiteInspire
sources.observed: Keep as a secondary web-design archive to verify manually before relying on it as a research source.

sources.name: Typewolf
sources.observed: A typography-focused source to add to the corpus when type research begins.

patterns.label: The hero is the thesis, not a component
patterns.cortexDecision: Every public section must support the hero's authored world, scale and calm; none may introduce a competing visual system.
reject: hero redesigns to accommodate weak lower sections

patterns.label: One continuous surface
patterns.cortexDecision: Use a continuous light canvas with local changes in composition, not boxed sections, visible separators or panelized backgrounds.

patterns.label: Typography carries the hierarchy
patterns.cortexDecision: Use Cortex Inter, scale, line breaks, weight and whitespace to create hierarchy. Accent color is secondary.
reject: mixing Syne or decorative display families into the public landing
small uppercase labels as the main structure

patterns.label: Pixel texture is material, not decoration
patterns.cortexDecision: Keep irregular, atmospheric, spatial pixel treatment with broad quiet areas.

patterns.label: One action per moment
patterns.cortexDecision: Each moment should have one understandable next action or none. Preserve the hero's dark capsule CTA language.

patterns.label: Navigation should orient, not perform
patterns.cortexDecision: Keep the compact capsule nav as a quiet anchor. Responsive behavior should reduce choices without introducing a second system.

patterns.label: Motion reveals relationships
patterns.cortexDecision: Use calm entrance, breathing drift, reveal, morph and guided scroll when they clarify the system.

patterns.label: Mobile is a designed composition
patterns.cortexDecision: Compose mobile deliberately around the hero crop, reading sequence and touch target hierarchy.

patterns.label: Organize research by design job
patterns.cortexDecision: Search the corpus by hero, nav, CTA, motion, mobile, typography, section rhythm and closing instead of collecting random inspiration.

patterns.label: Design decisions live beside code
patterns.cortexDecision: DESIGN.md and the JSON corpus are part of the implementation context and must be read before future public UI changes.

patterns.label: Quality beats novelty
patterns.cortexDecision: Select references because they solve hierarchy, clarity or interaction well, not because they are fashionable.

cortexFilters.reviewQuestion: Could this element be dropped into a generic AI SaaS template without changing its meaning? If yes, reject or re-author it.
